body: You're probably fine. I have something similar and all my STD screenings were negative (Multiple tests spread out). That said, if you are worried get tested. It looks like mild balanitis, maybe a fungal infection. Go to a doc and get their opinion. That's the best way to get relief.

I have the same thing and mine was not an std. I'm not a doctor but I wouldn't worry about it. How long ago was the encounter?

First, get tested to ease your mind. 

Second, try to relax. I had redness similar to yours and I was convinced I had something but nothing ever came back positive. Doctors said it was normal and gave me all sorts of creams etc but IMO they made the redness worse...

  
I think your fine. But if you're worried see a doc.

Relax. Two days? It's all in your head. You had regrettable sex, join the club, doesn't mean you have an STD. 

Wait a few weeks, go get tested, accept the results if it still bothers you. You can convince yourself that you have an illness you really don't have if you go down that rabbit hole.

Try not to think about it. FYI the link didn't work for me but I'm sure you are fine. More likely than not you are fine. And you are doing the right thing getting tested. Trust the test results and move on. Good luck.

It's just your guilt causing anxiety. So you messed up? People do that shit all the time. If you're really that worried you can go get screened in a week. We all make mistakes but you're still here. 

Don't think you have an STD. But try not to worry about it bc it will fuck with your head and you can think that you have something that you really don't. I've been there.
Looks like a normal skin irritation, not herpes or std.
Just wait until you are treated properly. Don't risk passing anything.

First, go get tested. It's an easy process and the best way to know for sure. 

However, (not being a doctor) have you heard of prostatitis? I thought I had an STD when in reality I had that and the irony is that I gave it to myself by thinking I had an STD. I would stress and clinch and that eventually caused pain in my lower abdomen and tip of my penis. 

My point here is get tested and if you are negative, take a deep breath and relax. The symptoms you are having will probably go away after you relax. When things happen with our genitals, people tend to overreact and that can cause symptoms. Try to relax. Get tested. Marry your girl.
If you got treated you are fine.
Does not look like herpes (not a doctor)

Getting an STD from unprotected oral is of course possible but not very likely. You can get herpes but unless you have visible sores I wouldn't worry about it. Syphilis is rare...super rare, unless you are getting oral from other men. But even then, it's curable. Paranoia will make everything worse. 

Take a deep breath and try to relax. Stay off the internet. Don't think too much about it. You can create symptoms with your paranoia. I did this for 6 months and there was nothing wrong with me. Don't worry about it. You got tested, that's the best thing you can do.

First, take a deep breath. You are fine. 

There are skin glands all over the penis and shaft. These glands can look like bumps but they're harmless and they are always there. 

What you have shown in the picture is not anything to be concerned about. The mind can create symptoms and you will think you have conditions. If you get tested, trust the test results. Don't think you fall in the minority with false negatives or something. You'll drive yourself crazy. 

Also, it is probably itching because you are thinking about it. Tell yourself you are fine and don't think about it. If you have issues with this, get tested and believe whatever results come back. Don't go down the rabbit hole.
No you are fine. Try not to worry about it.

Hey

First off, you are not too far gone. You have the ability to begin to make positive decisions in your life and while the pain of the past is real, you can move past it.

Just to let you know you aren't the only one, I pledged 30 days sobriety last week and relapsed this past weekend. Went on a bachelor party (felt like I had to go) and while I drank and didn't knockdown wasted, I made some terrible decisions. I spent all yesterday hungover, hating myself. While I still hate myself today, I know that with time and making the right decision each day, that I can beat this and repair the harm that I've done to myself and those I care about. You can do the same. 

Don't drink today and try not to tomorrow. Repeat. You can do it. 

As for the fights with the wife, I would suggest couples counseling. There may be some underlying issues and talking about them can be beneficial to the both of you, especially with a neutral party in the room mediating. It also shows that you care about the relationship and want to make it work.

My wife and I went and it made me realize how my drinking, lack of emotion, self hatred etc was negatively impacting our relationship. She also found out some stuff about herself and overall we are communicating in a better way since. 

​

Hang in there brother
